scope: Real imagery for one consistent developer website
selectionNotes: Replaces the very old 8 October album frames and 11 October aircraft/winter staging images as primary promotional media.

The V02 Haven full frame is the best available landscape hero without placement guides or HUD. The V03 close tent frame is archived for provenance but excluded from primary usage because prominent placement outlines dominate its composition.
These are archived real captures, not new renders or evidence of final redesigned native UI. No Unity/player run was performed.

Existing Fun & Ball images are genuine portrait gameplay; image 02 is the clearest hero because ball, fan and goal are readable together. Keep its portrait aspect, do not stretch or crop it into a landscape.
Moyva showcase frames are technical prototype images, not screenshots of a finished strategy game.
A bounded review of 14 recent native house/landmark scenes selected L065 autumn stone gateway as a second gallery image; complete 1024×1024 native frame, receipt hash verified.

furtherSelectionReview.reviewed: V02 final review sheets, V03 review sheets, initial teaser preview, native campaign scene captures
furtherSelectionReview.publicVideoAvailability: No video files in the tracked Git tree or GitHub releases. V02 QA_REPORT.md explicitly documents MP4 and full source PNGs as local files outside Git; V03 README gives local-only delivery paths.
furtherSelectionReview.contactSheetFinding: V02 includes wider river and bridge camera moments without guides, but complete frame tiles are only 480×270. V03 guide-free moments are similarly small and retain close tent composition. Neither is a suitable high-resolution website hero.
furtherSelectionReview.decision: Use the archived V02 1280×720 Haven preview as complete-frame hero; do not upscale a montage tile, invent a render, remove guides, or crop native scene content.

reviewedExcluded.recommended: Archive only; avoid primary or gallery promotion because placement guides are prominent.
